data.one_liner: Self-hosted OTA hotfix tool for Flutter with signed code and asset patches.
data.what_it_does: Allows shipping critical bug fixes and asset updates directly from your own servers or CDN without waiting for app store reviews. Patches apply on the next cold start and roll back automatically if they fail.
use_when: You need to push critical bug fixes to Dart code or assets without waiting for app store reviews
You want self-hosted over-the-air hotfixes for Android and iOS
avoid_when: Your updates involve native code changes, platform plugins, FFI packages, or Flutter SDK version upgrades
App store policies or regulated industries restrict downloading executable code
strengths: Enables self-hosted over-the-air updates for Flutter apps
Supports signed patches and automatic rollback capabilities
weaknesses: Cannot patch native code, platform plugins, or FFI packages
Requires careful adherence to store guidelines regarding dynamic code loading
data.setup_notes: Requires running initialization CLI commands and configuring build targets for Android and iOS.

alternatives.name: shorebird_code_push
alternatives.why_pick_it: An alternative code push solution for Flutter.
